header: Publishing terms authors ask us to explain

items.definition: A manuscript made public before review. Northstar accepts preprints from any server and does not count them as prior publication.
The period a dataset stays private after its paper appears. Authors may set up to 24 months, counted from the issue date.
The copy-edited article with the DOI. It is the version to cite, and the one that opens to all readers after 12 months.
